capabilities: Track note creation and modification statistics per day, folder, and tag
Group and filter Markdown tasks by status, priority, folder, and tag
Plan day schedules and migrate incomplete tasks between daily notes
Generate weekly, monthly, and yearly period plans from templates
Display GitHub commit activity and a contribution heatmap
extras: Statistics history is stored in VaultScope/activity.json inside the vault; the README notes it cannot recover edits made before installation or while disabled, and that notes in hidden directories may not be indexed. It states no data is sent to external services, except manual GitHub sync.
problem: Obsidian has no single overview that combines note activity statistics with day-to-day planning, so users must check several places to see what they did and what is due.

relations.evidence: connect the GitHub account. VaultScope verifies the account and loads repositories available to that token
maintains a local list of courses from Stepik, Udemy, and other platforms

summary: Dashboard that tracks vault note activity and combines daily notes, tasks, schedules, period plans, learning courses, and GitHub commit stats.
